title: Elementor Site Setup
description: Launch checklist for Elementor-built sites — kit import, globals, performance, and forms.

steps.title: Install Elementor & Pro (If Licensed)
steps.instructions: Install Elementor and Elementor Pro from client license. Activate only required widgets and disable unused experiments.

steps.title: Configure Site Settings & Kit
steps.instructions: Import or sync the site kit. Set global colors, typography, layout defaults, and favicon under Elementor → Site Settings.

steps.title: Assign Theme Builder Templates
steps.instructions: Create or assign header, footer, single, archive, and 404 templates. Confirm display conditions cover all key templates.

steps.title: Audit Global Widgets & Reusable Sections
steps.instructions: Replace duplicated sections with global widgets where appropriate. Document which globals client editors may change.

steps.title: Optimize Elementor Performance
steps.instructions: Enable improved asset loading, disable unused icon sets, and limit custom fonts. Test key pages with caching enabled.

steps.title: Test Elementor Forms & Actions
steps.instructions: Submit test entries on contact and lead forms. Verify email delivery, webhooks, and CRM integrations fire correctly.

steps.title: Responsive & Accessibility Pass
steps.instructions: Review mobile and tablet breakpoints on homepage and top landing pages. Fix contrast, focus order, and heading hierarchy.
